areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Lower emissions and reduced air and noise pollution are specific objectives with an indicator, via a change of the public-transport energy matrix.

areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy
areas.reason: Fleet electrification is a core pillar, with investment in vehicles and chargers.

areas.name: Business environment and opportunities
areas.reason: A mobility hub with a technology park fosters business, partnerships and start-up access to investors and mentors.

areas.name: Public-service delivery, management and citizen participation
areas.reason: Disruptive, research-based model: direct municipal management of public transport with separated contracts, giving more control and transparency.

areas.name: Technological development, innovation and modernization
areas.reason: Mobility hub in a technology park plus technological modernization through fleet electrification.
